title: third person ragdoll script
features: Third person ragdol. Zoom in/out with mouse scroll.
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function isRagdolled(value)
    return value == true or value == 1
end

local function resetTransparency(character)
    for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Decal") then
            part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
        end
    end
end

local renderConnection
local inputConnection
local ragdolledConnection
local yaw, pitch = 0, -0.15
local distance = 12
local minDistance, maxDistance = 5, 20

local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local function onInputChanged(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
        yaw -= input.Delta.X * 0.003
        pitch = math.clamp(pitch - input.Delta.Y * 0.003, -1.2, 1.2)
    elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
        distance = math.clamp(distance - input.Position.Z * 2, minDistance, maxDistance)
    end
end

local function updateCamera(value)
    local ragdollActive = isRagdolled(value)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end

    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")

    if renderConnection then
        renderConnection:Disconnect()
        renderConnection = nil
    end
    if inputConnection then
        inputConnection:Disconnect()
        inputConnection = nil
    end

    if ragdollActive then
        player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
        camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
        inputConnection = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(onInputChanged)
        renderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            resetTransparency(character)
            if head and head.Parent then
                local rot = CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, 0)
                local camPos = head.Position + rot:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, 0, distance))
                camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(camPos, head.Position)
            end
        end)
    else
        camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
        if humanoid then
            camera.CameraSubject = humanoid
        end
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
    end
end

local function hookRagdolled(character)
    if ragdolledConnection then
        ragdolledConnection:Disconnect()
        ragdolledConnection = nil
    end

    local stats = player:WaitForChild("stats")
    local ragdolled = stats:WaitForChild("ragdolled")
    
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            ragdolled.Value = true
        end)
    end

    ragdolledConnection = ragdolled.Changed:Connect(updateCamera)
    updateCamera(ragdolled.Value)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    task.wait(0.1)
    hookRagdolled(character)
end)

if player.Character then
    hookRagdolled(player.Character)
end
